column1: # Purpose: inventory of EVERY secret file of a deployment (deploy-design §10.1): its format
#   (kind), who creates it (generator), which services mount it, and how to rotate it.
#   Secret VALUES never live in the repo; files live in ${LC_SECRETS_DIR}
# Format: TAB-separated, 5 columns: file  kind  generator  consumers  rotation
#   kind: hex32 (64 hex chars) | b64url32 (43-char base64url of 32 bytes, identityhttp.ValidSecret)
#         | b64std32 (44-char std base64 of 32 bytes) | account_keyring ([{"id","key_base64"}],
#         internal/integrations/meta/env.go) | key_id | dsn_tcp | dsn_socket | opaque | meta_apps
#         tokenopen.LoadKeyring / metaads.LoadSealKeys; the public ring is derived from the private one).
#   generator: gen = secrets-init.sh creates it if missing; derive = computed from other secrets
#         (rewritten only when missing or with --rederive); owner = operator supplies it
#         (secrets-init.sh writes the literal __UNSET__, which lcentry treats as "unset").
# Runs as/in: read on the host by deploy/scripts/secrets-init.sh, preflight.sh (P02-P05, P09),
# Reads env / secrets: none itself. Row order matters: secrets-init.sh generates top to bottom
#   (passwords before DSNs, keyrings before active ids, BFF key before buyer keys).
# Used by: deploy/compose.yml top-level `secrets:` has exactly one entry per row.
# Status: DESIGN; verified by smoke S09 (create + idempotent re-run, 56 files after the R1 additions and the two platform-billing secrets:
#   5 logins x (pw,dsn), Stripe webhook signing keyring, Meta Page-token keyring, K_actor, K_link,
# Change rules: add/remove a row together with compose.yml `secrets:` and the consuming
#   service's *_FILE wiring; pw_/dsn_ rows must match the core rows of deploy/postgres/logins.tsv.
#   Losing commerce_account_keys_json makes stored PSP credentials undecryptable: keep the
#   owner's encrypted offline copy (docs/runbooks/backup-restore.md §密钥备份).
